text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Season's greet'ns, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's a special day. Yukino Bijin and I
are
throwing a little holiday party
together as a
gesture of our appreciation
for each other.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You really surprised me, Trainer! I didn't
expect
you t'deck out your office like
this.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Did y'do all this by yourself? The tinsel
and the
tree too?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, shucks! You've gone above and
beyond,
then! I'm over the moon!
choice_data_list: ユキノが喜んでくれるかなって

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
All this reminds me of the shindigs I used
t'have
with my family.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The moment I stepped in here, I could
feel my
heart fill'n right up with warm,
festive feelings!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: This isn't much by way of thanks, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I whipped up some food for us! They're
all local
dishes from Morioka, and I had
my mom coach
me through 'em over the
phone!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not too hot when it comes to cook'n,
so I was
just gonna pop out and pick up
some simple side
dishes...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But noth'n beats my mom's home cook'n,
so I
figured I'd give't a go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Don't judge it too harshly, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I left everyth'n in the hall, so just gimme
a second
and I'll go fetch't!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle, rattle...

No, I can't... This isn't my food. Must...
resist...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: JEEPERS CREEPERS!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no need t'apologize! You were just
look'n at
the food anyway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Alarmed by Yukino Bijin's yelp, I rush
out to the
hallway to find her standing
beside Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's also from the countryside, but now
she's
practically an idol in the racing
world. It wouldn't
be far-fetched to say
her popularity has had an
influence on
Yukino Bijin's.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, she's the pioneer who first
walked the
path Yukino Bijin now takes.
Yukino Bijin has
even used Oguri Cap as
inspiration during her
rough patches.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But I've never heard a yelp like that. I
must've
really scared you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's just how we talk back home...
And well,
overreact'n's a nasty habit o'
mine.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still... I'm sorry for interrupting your
party.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Don't you fret! It's all just stuff we're
reheat'n
anyway. In fact, why don't you
join us?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, I couldn't possibly. Didn't you make
all this
for your trainer?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm not so hungry that I'd get in the way
of
something so special.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I am that hungry. Could I have just a little bit?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You betcha!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Holy smokes... You're like a black hole!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I hear that a lot, but I can't really tell
myself...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've always been like this. Even back in

Kasamatsu.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Kasamatsu... That's your hometown,
right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes. And you're from Morioka, yes?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? You know where I'm from?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I've been hearing about you a
lot
recently.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I hear you've been working hard.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gadzooks!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Did I... Did I just get a compliment from Oguri?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Or well, maybe I've been listening more
'cause of
Tama. She's always yelling at
me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She says I always zone out and don't pay

attention to what's happening around
me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
She says I need to look out for all the
people
following in my footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh. That makes sense. There's lots of
us, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But I don't really get the idea of
following in
someone's footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
People can only be themselves. That
goes for me
and everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't everyone just follow their own
path?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
But I trust Tama, so I've been watching
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I heard about what
you've done.
You came here from far
away and captured
everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Everyone really loves you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes. They really do!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Keep working hard for everyone who's
cheering
for you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I will! Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Golly! Oguri sure is the cat's meow!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she knows what I've been
up to... I
feel like I'm walk'n on air!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I am! I'm gonna get strong enough t'hold
my own
against Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, whoops! The food!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run to the kitchen and heat
everyth'n
up!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Really? Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
This kinda reminds me of being back
home.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My dad'd get all proud of himself for
heat'n up
food and my mom would get
angry with him.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh no! I didn't mean it like that!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Please don't take it the wrong way!
Reheat'n food
is good enough for me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh! You were just teas'n me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We laugh and spend a fun and lively
evening
together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well, the food's nice and warm now, so
let's tuck
in!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I snuck out real quick while you were
see'n Oguri
off.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I haven't just been slack'n off these past
three
years, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I've grown a lot!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I'd like to think so anyway. What
d'you
think?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There're still times I don't feel confident
without
you there t'give me a push,
though...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Do y'think you can stick 'round for when
I'm feel'n
down in the dumps?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, let's get back to the party!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, the two of us have a
wonderfully
festive time.
